leads.title: Hawaii Marriage Equality Act (2013) - Hawaii State Legislature / Governor Neil Abercrombie
leads.documents: Legalization of same-sex marriage in Hawaii; Senate 20-4 and 19-4 votes, House 30-19 vote, signed Nov 13, 2013, marriages began Dec 2, 2013
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; cited as passed in special session Oct 28-Nov 12, 2013 and signed Nov 13

leads.title: Hawaii Supreme Court ruling May 1993 on same-sex marriage denial
leads.documents: Found restrictions on same-sex marriage unconstitutional; made Hawaii first state to consider legalizing same-sex marriage
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; cited as May 1993 ruling challenged denial of marriage licenses

leads.title: Hawaii Constitutional Amendment 2 (1998) and 2024 repeal referendum
leads.documents: Allowed legislature to ban same-sex marriage (70% voter approval 1998); repealed by voters 55.9% on Nov 5, 2024
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; cited as 1998 amendment leading to dismissal of lawsuit and 2024 repeal vote

leads.title: Hawaii anti-discrimination statutes - employment, housing, public accommodations
leads.documents: Explicit prohibition of discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity or expression in employment (1991 sexual orientation, 2011 gender identity), housing (2005), public accommodations (2006)

leads.title: Hawaii hate crime statute

leads.title: Hawaii gender marker laws - 2015 Act and 2019 X-option law
leads.documents: 2015 law allowing transgender people to change gender marker without surgery via Application for Amendment and Gender Designation Form; 2019 law adding X option to driver's licenses and birth certificates effective July 1, 2020

leads.title: Hawaii conversion therapy ban law effective July 1, 2018
leads.documents: Ban on conversion therapy on minors, passed via House/Senate conference committee May 2018 and signed by Gov David Ige

leads.title: Hawaii gay and trans panic defense abolition law (2019)
leads.documents: Abolition of gay and trans panic defenses, passed April 26, 2019 in conference committee, signed June 26, 2019 effective immediately

leads.title: June 2022 three-bill package - jury, LGBTIQ+ commission, health insurance
leads.documents: (1) jury selections cannot discriminate on sexual orientation/gender identity, (2) state LGBTIQ+ commission, (3) mandatory state health insurance coverage for sexual reassignment surgery; effective Jan 1, 2023; plus May 2022 transgender health insurance planning bill with emergency clause
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; cited as signed June 2022 by Governor, plus insurance non-discrimination since July 1, 2016

leads.title: Public Religion Research Institute (PRRI) 2019 and 2017 surveys / Williams Institute 2013 survey
leads.documents: High support for LGBTQ rights: 73% support anti-discrimination (2019), 68% support same-sex marriage and 74% support anti-discrimination (2017); 5.1% of Hawaii adults identified as LGBT (2013)
